title: Tracking Obligations
description: Which identifying data must be captured for an item's stock: lot (batch), expiry date, serial number. Used on items (structure/items.yaml) and on category.default_attributes.tracking, which items inherit field by field (see tools/compile.py). Unset fields resolve to the defaults: lot 'none', expiry.tracked false, serial.capture 'none'.

lot.description: none = no lot captured. optional = captured when the supplier provides one (e.g. on the goods-receipt label). required = no receipt without a lot.

tracked.description: Whether stock of this item carries an expiry date (best-before, use-by or expiry - not distinguished yet).

min_remaining_at_receipt_days.description: Minimum remaining shelf life at goods receipt; stock with less is not accepted. Only allowed when expiry is tracked. Outbound shelf-life floors are Allocation-as-Code's search_rule constraints, not this field.

total_shelf_life_days.description: Shelf life from production. Lets the expiry date be derived when the supplier gives only a production date. Only allowed when expiry is tracked.

capture.description: none = no serial numbers. outbound = captured at goods issue only. always = captured from goods receipt on, for every movement. Serial numbers are per base unit, the first entry of the item's packaging uom_hierarchy.
